status: selected two-worker product and actual-SQL source boundaries defined; runtime execution deferred until final review; compiler results are recorded separately

sampled_backend_marker.format: one JSON object per completed backend, after every history assertion

partition_marker.scope: only the96queueidentity/expiry rows; all124rows require passed exact test cases and source-bound registry, not this marker alone

boundaries.retirement_inputs: disposition 3 uses Some(worker_retired), None checkpoint and not_before_ms=current episode.now for every captured original token; ordinary dispositions 0/1/2 retain latest-revision inputs
boundaries.resolution_read_boundary: resolve_claim is one logical actual-API pure-read action; its two authoritative QueueSql awaits and internal interleavings are a named conformance boundary, not closed read-interleaving coverage
boundaries.primitive_clock_boundary: each generated primitive request uses current episode.now; the daemon's three retirement wall samples and dispatch/application races are reviewed adapter/conformance boundaries, not source-derived clock-race coverage
boundaries.reservation_conservation_boundary: conservation is checked for unexpired queue authority only; expired Running rows and residue remain represented, with no independent complete-residue conservation guarantee until reclaim/prune
boundaries.domain_reacquisition_boundary: each owner can acquire at most once; release or expiry does not reset its budget, so same-owner release-to-reacquire cycles are excluded
boundaries.foreign_holder_boundary: foreign-holder is a third adversarial domain-lease owner, not either worker node, with one independent acquisition budget
boundaries.retirement_sequence_boundary: the graph supplies separate actual settle and logical resolve primitives; daemon drain/local-token/first-settle/resolve/optional-second-settle sequencing is a reviewed source and daemon-conformance boundary composed by the temporal model
boundaries.cleanup_boundary: local cleanup needs bounded retirement calls to return, not eventual successful acknowledgement; errors are logged and finish returns while durable authority may remain
boundaries.dispatch_time_noninterference: for retirement fence Some(F), resolve_claim reads dispatched_at_ms only in its skipped fence-is-none window branch; neither SQL query nor later classification reads it, so a representative dispatch sample preserves results at fixed now/read outcomes; this is a reviewed source lemma, not a machine proof
boundaries.queue_sql_boundary: all generated queue primitives use QueueSql::queue_sql, not queue_transaction; ReplyBoundary passes queue_transaction through without fault injection, so multi-statement transaction faults are outside this slice
boundaries.schema_snapshot_boundary: canonical durable rows cover exactly the nine snapshot_tables; all installed schema objects are hash-bound for identity, not complete row snapshots or proofs of unrelated tables
boundaries.savepoint_boundary: no closure transition invokes queue_transaction or nested explicit transactions; test savepoints bracket sequential primitives on the production writer and any savepoint/SQL failure aborts closure
boundaries.refusal_observation: the existing BFS full-canonical equality guard already rejects every refused edge mutation; direct non-graph conformance can additionally enable apply's durable snapshot observer; no pre-existing closure gap is claimed

fields.scope: actual primitive conformance; daemon sequence is a separate boundary

fields.named_failure: FailedCasAtomicity: refused primitive changed durable rows

daemon_retirement_boundary.claim: reviewed source and separately defined daemon conformance, not exercised by core primitive tests; no execution or whole-Rust refinement claimed

review_corrections.S2: original BFS and checker already checked full-canonical refused self-edges; the direct observer serves non-graph conformance and no pre-existing closure gap is claimed
review_corrections.R1-C2: Some(fence) dispatch-time noninterference is reviewed from actual resolve_claim source; first retirement sample may differ from resolve sample, while request.now_ms/application-time scope remains explicitly bounded
